title: Enzo Almeida
text:
About
My current research work uses administrative microdata to study workers and firms. I am especially interested in how labour market institutions and migration shape workers’ outcomes and economic adjustment.
Before joining the Università degli Studi di Torino and Collegio Carlo Alberto, I worked as pre-doctoral research assistant at Nova SBE and as an intern and consultant at the International Labour Organization.
